def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    row_indices = list(range(1, len(grid), 2))
    cols = [1, 4, 7, 10, 13]

    # Treat each variable column as a top-to-bottom binary number and sort
    # the columns in ascending order.
    vectors = [
        tuple(1 if grid[r][c] != 0 else 0 for r in row_indices)
        for c in cols
    ]
    ordered = sorted(vectors)
    color = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)

    for i, r in enumerate(row_indices):
        for j, c in enumerate(cols):
            out[r][c] = color if ordered[j][i] else 0

    return out
